description: This file defines the interface CohortService, which provides API methods for managing cohorts and cohort memberships within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, voiding, and deleting cohort data, as well as managing patient memberships in these cohorts.

methods.name: setCohortDAO
methods.description: Sets the CohortDAO implementation that this service will use to interact with the database.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Creates or updates a Cohort in the database. Throws an exception if any patient IDs in the cohort don't exist.

methods.name: voidCohort
methods.description: Voids a specified cohort, making it inactive from the user's perspective, with a provided reason.

methods.name: purgeCohort
methods.description: Completely removes a cohort from the database, irreversible.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a cohort by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getCohortByName
methods.description: Retrieves a non-voided cohort by its name, since version 2.1.0.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving cohort by name.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided cohorts.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all cohorts, including voided ones, based on parameter.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves list of cohorts matching a name fragment, or all if input is empty.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient
methods.description: Deprecated. Finds all cohorts containing a specific patient (without including voided).

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Finds all non-voided cohorts containing a patient by ID.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort
methods.description: Adds a patient to a cohort, creating a membership if not already present.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort
methods.description: Deprecated. Removes a patient from a cohort by voiding their membership.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort object by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership object by its UUID.

methods.name: purgeCohortMembership
methods.description: Removes a CohortMembership from its parent cohort.

methods.name: voidCohortMembership
methods.description: Voids a CohortMembership, marking it as inactive.

methods.name: endCohortMembership
methods.description: Ends a CohortMembership, optionally at the specified date.

methods.name: notifyPatientVoided
methods.description: Internal method to void all cohort memberships of a patient who was voided.

methods.name: notifyPatientUnvoided
methods.description: Internal method to unvoid cohort memberships when a patient is unvoided.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves cohort memberships for a patient, with optional date and voided inclusion.
